description: Securely read from and write to authorized workspace directories.

list_directory.description: List the contents of a directory in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to list. Prefix with '{{REL_WS}}/{{WORKSPACE_ID}}/'. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple paths, emit multiple tool call tags.

read_file.description: Read the content of a file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to read. Prefix with '{{REL_WS}}/{{WORKSPACE_ID}}/'. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple files, emit multiple tool call tags.

write_file.description: Write content to a file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to write. Prefix with '{{REL_WS}}/{{WORKSPACE_ID}}/'. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple files, emit multiple tool call tags.
